candidates.review_note: A positive subarray sum has root determined by prefix residues mod9. For any ordered pair of residues, a range contains a qualifying subarray iff earliest first prefix precedes latest second prefix and their actual sums differ. This distinguishes zero from positive multiples of9; zero exists iff a zero element occurs. Nine sorted prefix-position lists answer each query without enumerating subarrays.

Order candy types by value per weight using exact cross-products. In an optimum, the worse type count can be below Wr/gcd(Wr,Wb), since exchanging that many for better-type candies preserves weight and does not reduce joy. If Wr is small enumerate this count; if large enumerate affordable better-type count. Both branches O(sqrt C).

Subset/end-dish DP records maximum satisfaction after selecting precisely that subset in an order ending at last. Appending an unused dish adds its base satisfaction and directed immediate-adjacency bonus. Only size-m subsets qualify; missing bonuses are zero and 64-bit arrays avoid overflow and object overhead.

Centroid decomposition examines paths through each centroid. For one child subtree, match its distances against previously processed subtrees plus the centroid; insert after querying to avoid using same-subtree paths prematurely. Recurse over remaining components iteratively. Positive edge lengths allow pruning distances above maximum query; deduplicate queries and retain original output order.

Fenwick order statistics map current l/r ranks to immutable original positions. Per-character sorted positions plus successor DSU skip deleted occurrences. Delete each matching original index at most once, update alive counts, and preserve survivors in original order. O((n+m)logn) rather than repeated string slicing.

Each row contributes independently: at column j use max array element over indices max(0,j-slack)..min(length-1,j), with optional zero only if the row can avoid j. Short rows have prefix/suffix maxima and a constant middle handled by difference array; long rows scan O(w)<=O(2length) using monotonic deque. Overall O(total input length+w), including negative values.

Suffix automaton gives each substring path its occurrence multiplicity. Propagate terminal occurrences through suffix links, then count weighted paths in decreasing state length. Lexicographic descent subtracts entire branch counts and consumes occurrence copies before longer extensions. Counts equal substrings separately as required; insufficient total yields exact failure text.
